cases.situation: Freelance copywriter here. My client Megan wants 12 product pages by Friday 2 October, but she only sent the product specs yesterday, 4 days late. I need until Wednesday 7 October.
cases.reply: Hi Megan, a heads-up now rather than Thursday night: the product specs arrived yesterday, four days later than planned, so all 12 pages by Friday would mean rushing them. I'd like to move delivery to Wednesday the 7th. If Friday is tied to your launch, I'll send the six hero products Friday and the rest Wednesday. Which works better for you?
cases.note: One line of reason, a specific new date, and a partial-delivery trade in case the date is fixed.

cases.situation: 研究生，导师李老师让我周五交论文第三章初稿。上周发现第二组实验的参数设错了要重跑，数据下周一才能出来，周五肯定交不了完整的。想申请延到下周三。
cases.reply: 李老师，您好。第三章初稿原定周五交，但上周发现第二组实验的参数设置有误，需要重跑，数据周一才能出来。想跟您申请延到下周三晚上交完整版。如果周五您需要先看框架，我周五可以先把前两节和图表初稿发给您。您看哪种方式合适？
cases.note: 对导师也是同样结构：一句原因、一个具体日期、一个部分交付的备选。

cases.situation: I promised my sister Jess I'd finish her wedding slideshow by Saturday but work exploded this week. Wedding is in 3 weeks so there's slack, just feel bad. I'd like until next Thursday.
cases.reply: Hey Jess, I said I'd have the slideshow done by Saturday and I'm going to need until next Thursday; work has been flat out this week and I want to do it properly, not rush it. That still leaves two weeks before the wedding. Is that okay, or do you need it sooner for anything?
cases.note: Personal deadlines get the same shape, just warmer and shorter. No paragraph of guilt.

cases.situation: 我叫李晓雯，在职读周末班MBA，《管理会计》课程论文昨天周一晚上12点截止，因为公司季度结账连续加班没交上。想给任课的陈老师发邮件，问能不能周四交。
cases.reply: 陈老师您好，我是周末班的李晓雯。《管理会计》课程论文昨晚12点截止，我没有按时提交，也没有提前跟您说明，这是我的问题。这周公司季度结账，连续加班耽误了进度。能否允许我在本周四，10月1日晚上12点前提交？如果不方便延期，我今晚先把已完成的部分发给您，逾期扣分我也接受。谢谢老师。
cases.note: 已经逾期时，先认没提前说，再给一个具体新时间和部分交付的备选，理由只写一句。

cases.situation: My employer switched payroll systems and my September pay is delayed until October 9. Rent ($1,650) is due October 1 to my landlord, Mr. Delgado, who's been easy to deal with for two years; I could manage $600 on the 1st. I want to ask now, not on the 1st.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Delgado, a heads-up now rather than on the 1st: my employer's payroll switch has pushed my September pay to October 9. Could I pay October's rent on Friday October 9 instead? If it helps, I can send $600 on the 1st and the remaining $1,050 on the 9th. Would either of those work for you?
cases.note: Money deadlines get the same shape: ask before the due date, one line of reason, an exact new date and a partial payment as the trade.

cases.situation: I asked my manager Nadia if the vendor comparison report could move from Friday to next Tuesday because two of the six vendors, Tessaly and Brookvane, still haven't sent pricing; I chased both again today. She said no, leadership reviews it Monday morning. What do I say back?
cases.reply: Understood, Monday's review is fixed. Here's what I can do: by Friday 5pm you'll have the full comparison for the four vendors who've sent pricing, with Tessaly and Brookvane marked as pending. I've chased both again today, and if their numbers arrive over the weekend I'll add them before 8am Monday. Does that work for the review?
cases.note: After a no, stop asking for time and offer the partial version that fits the downstream deadline.

cases.situation: I'm Laila Hassan, director of Open Pages Literacy, a small nonprofit. Our annual grant report to the Hollins Foundation is due Thursday Oct 15, but our auditor is behind and the audited financials won't be final until Oct 23. Our program officer is Ms. Adebayo, and I want to ask now rather than at the last minute.
cases.reply:
Dear Ms. Adebayo,
I'm writing early about our annual report, due Thursday 15 October. Our audit is running late, and the audited financials won't be final until 23 October. Could we submit the full report by Monday 26 October? If the 15th feeds into your committee's timeline, I can send the narrative and outcomes sections on the 15th and the financials on the 26th.
Thank you for considering it.
Kind regards,
Laila Hassan
Director, Open Pages Literacy
cases.note: Asked two weeks out with one line of reason, an exact date, and a split delivery in case the original date feeds something downstream.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance developer building a booking site for a physio clinic. The original deadline was Sept 25, and my client Dr. Patel already agreed to move it to this Friday, Oct 2. The booking calendar and pages are ready, but the card payment step is fighting me and I need until Wednesday Oct 7.
cases.reply: Hi Dr. Patel, I want to flag this early: the card payment step won't be ready by this Friday, 2 October, and I know this is the second time I've moved the date. I'd like until Wednesday 7 October to finish it properly. The booking calendar and all the pages are ready, so if you'd like, they can go live on Friday with patients paying at the clinic until then. Would that work for your launch?
cases.note: A second extension is a bigger conversation: name it as the second, ship something useful on the original date, and don't ask for a third.

cases.situation: 拿到一家公司的offer，HR李经理让我10月9日（周五）前答复。但我更想去的另一家公司终面在10月13日（周二）。想请李经理把答复时间延到10月16日，又怕显得不重视。
cases.reply: 李经理您好，非常感谢这份offer，我对这个岗位是认真在考虑的。想跟您商量一下答复时间：能否从10月9日（周五）延到10月16日（周五）？我还有一个之前就在进行的面试流程，13日结束，想两边都了解清楚后给您一个确定的答复，而不是仓促决定。如果16日有困难，请告诉我最晚可以到哪天，我会按那个时间答复。
cases.note: 要早提、给具体新日期、理由一句话说实话；再留一个退路让对方好答应。

cases.situation: I asked my client Lauren on Monday to move her brand guide from Friday Oct 2 to Wednesday Oct 7 because the photographer delivered late. She agreed but added 'honestly this should have been flagged last week.' She's right, I sat on it.
cases.reply: Fair, I should have flagged it last week when the photos slipped. The full guide will be with you by 10am Wednesday Oct 7, and I'll send the logo and colour pages on Friday so your team can start on the signage.
cases.note: When they're annoyed you asked late: one line of ownership, the date, a partial delivery, and no defence.

cases.situation: 租的房子10月31日到期，已经跟房东张阿姨说好不续了，月租4500。结果新房装修延期，要11月14日才能搬进去。想问她能不能让我多住两周，房租按天算。
cases.reply: 张阿姨您好，想早点跟您商量一件事。我新房的装修延期了，要到11月14日（周六）才能入住。能不能让我多住两周，11月14日搬走？房租按天算，这两周是2,100元，我10月31日前一次付清。如果您已经约了新租客或者有别的安排，也请直接告诉我，我再想办法。
cases.note: 越早问越好：一句原因、一个具体日期、钱怎么算说清楚，再给对方一个方便说不的台阶。

cases.situation: I'm a first-time author. My manuscript is due to my editor, Ruth, on December 1, but my mother has been seriously ill since the summer and I've lost about two months of writing; eight of the twelve chapters are drafted. I want to ask for February 15 now, not in November.
cases.reply: Hi Ruth, I'm writing now rather than in November: my mother has been seriously ill since the summer and I've lost about two months of writing time. I'd like to ask to move the manuscript from 1 December to 15 February. If the schedule needs something sooner, I can send the first eight chapters, about two-thirds of the book, by 1 December so editing can start. Would either of those work?
cases.note: Big deadline, months out: one line of reason with no medical detail, a firm new date, and a partial delivery as the trade.

cases.situation: 我在市场部，答应10月16日（周五）把三季度十个活动的费用明细交给财务部的赵姐，她要用来做月度结账。其中八个活动的发票齐了，还有两家代理商的发票没到，最快下周一才能收齐。想在企业微信上跟她说延到10月20日（周二）。
cases.reply: 赵姐，提前跟你说一下：三季度活动费用明细原定16号周五给你，但还有两家代理商的发票没到，最快下周一才能收齐。能不能让我20号周二中午前给你完整版？如果你周五就要开始做账，我16号先把已经齐全的八个活动发你，剩下两家20号补上。你看哪种方便？
cases.note: 跨部门同事没有义务等你：早说、给具体时间，并按她的结账节奏提供先交一部分的方案。

cases.situation: Ich habe eine kleine Schreinerei. Herr Brandt bekommt einen Esstisch aus Eiche, zugesagt für Freitag, 16. Oktober, aber unser Holzlieferant liefert die Platte eine Woche zu spät; realistisch schaffe ich Freitag, 30. Oktober. In der Werkstatt haben wir einen Leihtisch, den ich ihm für die Zwischenzeit anbieten kann.
cases.reply: Guten Tag Herr Brandt, ich melde mich lieber jetzt als kurz vor dem Termin: Unser Holzlieferant liefert die Eichenplatte für Ihren Tisch eine Woche später als vereinbart. Wäre eine Lieferung am Freitag, 30. Oktober, statt am 16. Oktober für Sie in Ordnung? Dann habe ich nach Eingang der Platte genug Zeit, den Tisch ohne Eile so zu fertigen, wie wir ihn besprochen haben. Falls Sie ihn vorher für einen Anlass brauchen, bringe ich Ihnen bis dahin gern einen Leihtisch aus unserer Werkstatt vorbei.
cases.note: Wenn man selbst der Lieferant ist, entscheidet der Kunde über die Verlängerung: früh fragen und eine Überbrückung anbieten.

cases.situation: University group project, four of us. I told the group I'd have my market analysis section in our shared doc by Sunday Oct 4, but my grandmother is in hospital and I've been visiting every day. I need until Tuesday Oct 6. Final submission is Thursday Oct 8.
cases.reply: Hi all, flagging this now rather than on Sunday: I need until Tuesday 6 October, 6pm, for the market analysis section. Family stuff has taken most of this week. That still leaves Wednesday to pull everything together before Thursday's deadline. So nobody's blocked, I'll post the competitor table and my key numbers by Sunday so you can start writing from them. Does that work for everyone?
cases.note: Peers who share a grade: the new date, one line of reason with no detail, and something useful on the original date so no one waits on you.

cases.situation: I'm Arjun, interviewing for a data analyst role at Fernmoor Analytics. The recruiter, Sofia, sent a take-home case study on Monday, due Friday Oct 2 at noon. I have a production release at my current job on Thursday night and want to ask for Monday Oct 5 at noon instead.
cases.reply:
Hi Sofia, thank you for sending the case study. I'm asking now rather than on Friday: I have a release at my current job on Thursday night, which would leave me only a few rushed hours for it. Could I submit by Monday 5 October at noon instead? If Friday is tied to the panel's schedule, I'll send it on time and note which parts I'd take further with more time.
Thanks,
Arjun
cases.note: A hiring deadline: ask early, one line of reason that shows you take your current job seriously, and offer to hit the original date if it matters.

cases.situation: I'm Ellie Moss, a second-year undergraduate. My history essay for Dr. Hale is due Friday 9 October, and I've had flu since Sunday 4 October, with a doctor's note covering 4 to 8 October. The module handbook says extensions of more than 48 hours go through the department's extenuating circumstances form, and I want to ask for Wednesday 14 October.
cases.reply:
Dear Dr. Hale,
I'm writing to ask for an extension on my history essay, due Friday 9 October, to Wednesday 14 October. I've had flu since Sunday and have a doctor's note covering 4 to 8 October. As the module handbook asks for extensions over 48 hours to go through the extenuating circumstances form, I'll submit the form with the note today. Would you be willing to support the request?
Kind regards,
Ellie Moss
cases.note: When the course has a formal extension process, follow it and say so; the email to the tutor asks for support, not a way around the rules.

cases.situation: Je suis traductrice indépendante. L'agence (chef de projet : Thomas) attend la traduction d'un manuel de 40 pages pour vendredi 2 octobre, mais hier le client final a ajouté 12 pages. Je peux livrer les 40 pages prévues vendredi et les 12 nouvelles le mercredi 7 octobre.
cases.reply: Bonjour Thomas, je vous écris dès aujourd'hui au sujet du manuel : avec les 12 pages ajoutées hier par le client, je ne pourrai pas tout livrer vendredi avec la qualité attendue. Je vous propose de livrer les 40 pages prévues ce vendredi 2 octobre, comme convenu, et les 12 nouvelles pages le mercredi 7 octobre. Est-ce que ce découpage convient au client, ou a-t-il besoin de certaines des nouvelles pages en priorité ?
cases.note: Quand le périmètre grandit, on livre l'original à l'heure et on ne décale que l'ajout.

cases.situation: 儿子小宇上小学四年级，班主任王老师布置的科学手抄报国庆后10月12日（周一）交。他这周肺炎住院，医生说大概10月10日出院，出院后还要在家休息几天。我想现在就在微信上跟王老师说，申请延到10月16日（周五）。
cases.reply: 王老师您好，我是小宇妈妈。想提前跟您说一声：小宇这周因为肺炎住院了，医生说大概10月10日出院，之后还要在家休息几天。科学手抄报原定10月12日（周一）交，想申请延到10月16日（周五）。如果12日需要先交点什么，我们可以先把选题和草图拍照发给您。谢谢王老师！
cases.note: 替孩子向老师申请：尽早说，一句原因，具体的新日期，再给一个先交一部分的选项。

cases.situation: I accepted an offer at Ardent Labs to start Monday 19 October; my new manager is Carla. I resigned from my current job on Monday 28 September, and HR pointed out my contract requires four weeks' notice, not the two I'd assumed, so my last day here is Monday 26 October. I want to ask Carla to move my start to Monday 2 November.
cases.reply: Hi Carla, I wanted to flag this as soon as I knew. I resigned on Monday, and my contract here requires four weeks' notice rather than the two I'd planned for, so my last day is Monday 26 October. Could I start on Monday 2 November instead of 19 October? If anything is tied to the 19th, I'm happy to read onboarding material or join a short intro call before I start. Does that work for you?
cases.note: A start date is a deadline too: say it the day you find out, one line of reason from the contract, an exact date, and something useful in the gap.

cases.situation: I'm Daniel Mercer. I agreed to peer-review a manuscript, JCE-2026-0412, for the Journal of Coastal Ecology; the editor is Dr. Mireille Okafor and the review is due Monday Oct 5. My institution just moved an internal grant deadline to Oct 6 and it's eaten my week; I could do the review by Monday Oct 12, but if that's too late I'd rather step aside now.
cases.reply:
Dear Dr. Okafor,
I'm writing now rather than on the 5th about my review of JCE-2026-0412. An internal grant deadline at my institution has moved to 6 October and taken this week. Could I send the review by Monday 12 October instead? If that's too late for your decision timeline, tell me and I'll step aside today so you can invite another reviewer without losing more time.
With apologies for the change,
Daniel Mercer
cases.note: When the work is a favour to someone's process, the alternative to a new date is stepping aside early, not a rushed review.

cases.situation: 我开了家小超市，欠供应商王总这批饮料货款4.8万元，约好10月15日（周四）付清。一家单位团购的6万元回款推迟到了月底，15日我只能先付2.4万，剩下的2.4万最晚10月30日（周五）能付。跟王总合作三年了，从没拖过款。
cases.reply: 王总，提前跟您说一声：这批饮料的4.8万货款，原定10月15日（周四）付清，我这边有一笔团购回款推迟到了月底。我想15日先付2.4万，剩下的2.4万最晚10月30日（周五）付清。合作三年我从没拖过款，这次也想早点跟您讲清楚。您看这样安排可以吗？
cases.note: 提前两周说，给具体金额和日期，先付一半；延期后的日期一定要守住，第二次延期就是另一场谈话了。

cases.situation: 我在申请学校的海外交换奖学金，材料10月9日（周五）截止，我自己的部分都已经提交了。推荐人张教授在国外开会，说最早10月14日（周三）才能上传推荐信。想发邮件问国际处的刘老师，推荐信能不能晚几天到。
cases.reply: 刘老师您好，我是本次海外交换奖学金的申请人，个人材料已经全部在系统里提交。我的推荐人张教授目前在国外开会，最早10月14日（周三）才能上传推荐信，比10月9日（周五）的截止时间晚五天。想请问推荐信能否在10月14日前补交？如果截止时间不能调整，也请您告诉我，我会马上联系张教授，看能否提前。谢谢您！
cases.note: 别人的延误导致要延期：先说明自己那部分已按时完成，给出具体日期，再问清楚不能延时该怎么办。

cases.situation: I'm the developer on our booking app, and the release is planned for Tuesday Oct 6. QA just found a crash at login on older phones, and I need until Friday Oct 9 to fix and retest it. Marketing has a launch email going out Wednesday Oct 7. I want to post in our #release Slack channel, tagging our PM Grace and the marketing lead Owen.
cases.reply: @Grace @Owen heads-up on the release: QA found a crash at login on older phones, so I'd like to move the release from Tuesday 6 October to Friday 9 October to fix and retest it properly. That clashes with the launch email on Wednesday the 7th. Could the email move to Monday the 12th, or go out on the 7th as a 'coming Friday' announcement? Which works better on your side?
cases.note: In a public channel, tag the people downstream and give them a choice about their part, not just your new date.

cases.situation: I'm a policy analyst. I told my director, Ruth, I'd have the housing survey report to her by Friday Oct 9 for the council briefing on Wednesday Oct 14. That's on me: I underestimated the 1,800 open-text responses. The numbers and charts will be done by Friday, but the themes from the comments won't be ready until Tuesday Oct 13.
cases.reply: Ruth, a heads-up on the housing survey report: I underestimated the 1,800 open-text responses. I can send the numbers and charts by Friday 9 October as planned, and the themes from the comments by Tuesday 13 October, which still leaves a day before the briefing on the 14th. Would that work, or would you rather I trim the comment analysis and send everything on Friday?
cases.note: When the delay is your own misjudgment, say so in one line, ask a week early, and offer the split or the cut.

cases.situation: We're buying a flat and the contract sets completion for Friday 16 October. Yesterday our lender told us final mortgage approval won't come through until Friday 23 October because the valuation was delayed. I want to email the seller's agent, Mark Ellis, today to ask for completion on Monday 26 October; our solicitor is already checking what the contract allows.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, I wanted to tell you as soon as we knew: our lender says final mortgage approval won't come through until Friday 23 October, because the valuation was delayed. Could you ask the sellers whether completion could move from Friday 16 October to Monday 26 October? Our solicitor is checking what the contract allows and will be in touch with theirs. If the sellers have a move of their own tied to the 16th, please let us know, so we can understand what's at stake on their side.
cases.note: With a contract date, ask the day you know, let the solicitors handle the terms, and don't agree to anything before yours has checked the contract.

cases.situation: 我叫王晨，10月12日（周一）入职一家新公司，HR小刘让我入职当天交齐材料，包括学位证书原件。我的学位证书丢了，母校补办的学位证明10月20日（周二）才能寄到，学校已经给了我受理回执。其他材料都准备好了，想在微信上跟小刘申请延到10月21日（周三）交。
cases.reply: 小刘你好，我是10月12日（周一）入职的王晨。提前跟你说一声：我的学位证书丢了，母校补办的学位证明10月20日（周二）才能寄到，想申请延到10月21日（周三）交，其他材料入职当天都会交齐。学校的受理回执我先拍照发你。你看这样可以吗？如果21日不行，麻烦告诉我还需要怎么处理。
cases.note: 对HR申请延期：一句原因，一个具体日期，先给能证明正在办理的凭证，其余材料照常交齐。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance writer. On Tuesday I emailed Priya, my editor at a trade magazine, asking to move my 1,500-word feature on urban beekeeping from Friday Oct 2 to Tuesday Oct 6, because one interviewee, a beekeeper called Tom Rees, rescheduled to Monday. No reply, and the piece is complete without him; I could add his quotes by Tuesday Oct 6.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, since I haven't heard back about the extension, I'm sticking to today's deadline: the beekeeping feature is attached, complete at 1,500 words, using the interviews I have. I'm speaking to Tom Rees on Monday, so if you'd like his quotes in it, I can send a revised version by Tuesday 6 October. Otherwise this one is ready to go.
cases.note: Silence is not a yes: deliver on the original date and offer the extra as optional.

cases.situation: 我们在给新房装修比价，云杉装饰报价12.6万，报价单上写着有效期到10月10日（周六）。我们还在等银行装修贷的审批，也在对比方案，最晚10月20日（周二）能定。想在微信上问对接的设计师孙工，能不能把报价保留到20日。
cases.reply: 孙工您好，想提前跟您商量一下：12.6万的报价有效期到10月10日（周六），我们这边还在等装修贷审批，也在对比方案，最晚10月20日（周二）能定下来。能不能把这个报价保留到20日？如果保留不了这么久，请告诉我最晚能到哪天，或者到期后价格会怎么变，我们心里好有数。
cases.note: 请卖方延长报价有效期也是延期：早问、给具体日期、一句实话做原因，并问清不行时会怎样。

cases.situation: I manage Leah, a designer on my team. I promised her written feedback on her promotion case by Friday 2 October so she can revise it before the committee deadline on Friday 16 October. A client escalation has eaten my week and I need until Wednesday 7 October, though I could send her my top three points on Friday.
cases.reply: Hi Leah, I want to tell you now rather than on Friday: I promised you written feedback on your promotion case by Friday 2 October, and I need until Wednesday 7 October. A client escalation has taken most of my week, and your case deserves a proper read, not a rushed one. That still leaves you more than a week before the committee deadline on the 16th. If you'd rather have something sooner, I can send my top three points on Friday and the full notes on Wednesday. Which would help you more?
cases.note: Asking someone junior for time: they will rarely say no to their manager, so give them a real choice and keep the new date.

cases.situation: I borrowed my coworker Dev's 70-200mm lens to shoot my cousin's wedding on Saturday 3 October and promised it back on Monday 5 October. My cousin has now asked me to photograph the family brunch on Saturday 10 October too, so I'd like to keep it until Monday 12 October and give it back with the glass cleaned. Dev mentioned he has his own shoot on Saturday 17 October.
cases.reply: Hi Dev, a heads-up now rather than on Monday: my cousin has asked me to shoot the family brunch on Saturday 10 October as well. Could I hang on to the 70-200 until Monday 12 October instead of this Monday? It'll come back with the glass cleaned, still well ahead of your shoot on the 17th. If you'd rather have it back as planned, no problem at all, I'll return it on Monday 5 October and sort something else for the brunch.
cases.note: Borrowed kit has a deadline too: ask before the return date, name the new day, and show it won't touch their own plans.

cases.situation: 町内会で会報の編集をボランティアで担当しています。会長の佐藤さんには10月9日（金）までに原稿をまとめて渡すと言っていましたが、仕事の繁忙期と重なって間に合わず、10月14日（水）まで待ってほしいです。印刷所の締め切りは10月16日（金）で、表紙と行事予定のページはもうできています。
cases.reply: 佐藤会長、お疲れさまです。会報の原稿について、早めにご相談させてください。10月9日（金）にお渡しするとお約束していましたが、仕事の繁忙期と重なり、間に合いそうにありません。10月14日（水）までお待ちいただけないでしょうか。印刷所の締め切りの16日（金）には間に合わせます。9日の時点で必要なものがあれば、もうできている表紙と行事予定のページを先にお送りします。
cases.note: ボランティアの役割でも構造は同じ：早めに、理由は一言、具体的な日付、先に渡せる部分。

cases.situation: 我们是一家小印刷厂“墨林印务”，在投明德中学毕业纪念册的报价，对接的采购赵老师要求10月9日（周五）前交报价。纸张供应商说新一季纸价10月12日（周一）才出，我想把报价延到10月13日（周二）交；如果不能延，就10月9日按现在的纸价报，并注明纸价的有效期。
cases.reply: 赵老师您好，我是墨林印务的，关于毕业纪念册的报价想提前跟您商量一下。我们纸张供应商的新一季纸价要10月12日（周一）才出，想申请把报价延到10月13日（周二）交，这样报给您的价格不会过几天又变。如果截止时间需要对所有报价单位统一、不方便延，我们就10月9日（周五）按现在的纸价按时交，并在报价里注明纸价的有效期。您看哪种方式合适？
cases.note: 向采购方申请延期：一句原因、一个具体日期，再主动给出按原日期提交的方案，尊重对其他报价方的公平。

cases.situation: Organizo la comida de la primera comunión de mi hija el sábado 24 de octubre en el restaurante El Olivar. Sergio, el encargado, necesita el número final de invitados el viernes 9 de octubre, pero aún me faltan 15 confirmaciones. Ya tengo 60 seguros y quiero pedirle hasta el martes 13 de octubre.
cases.reply: Hola Sergio, te escribo con tiempo por lo de la comunión del sábado 24 de octubre. Todavía me faltan 15 confirmaciones, así que el viernes 9 no voy a poder darte el número final. ¿Podría dártelo el martes 13 de octubre? Mientras tanto, te confirmo ya 60 invitados seguros, para que puedas ir organizándote con ese mínimo. Si el viernes es una fecha cerrada por los proveedores, dímelo y te paso la cifra más ajustada que tenga ese día.
cases.note: Con un proveedor de eventos, dar ya el mínimo seguro es la entrega parcial que hace fácil decir que sí.

cases.situation: 我是做小程序外包的。客户陈总9月底加了会员积分功能，我上周提出把上线从10月16日（周五）延到10月23日（周五）。他回我：“周末加加班不就赶出来了？”我这周末有安排，也不想赶工出错；可以16日先上线不含积分的版本，积分功能23日上。
cases.reply: 陈总，理解您想按16日上线。周末加班我这边排不开，而且积分要是赶出来，出错的风险比较大。我的方案是：16日（周五）按时上线不含积分的版本，积分功能23日（周五）上线。如果您更希望一次全部上线，那就统一定在23日。您看哪种更合适？
cases.note: 对方用“加加班”回应时，不辩解，把选择题交回去：先上线一部分，或者整体换到新日期。
